sections.title: Industry Councils
sections.sublabel: I-CAR's industry councils provide specialized expertise and perspectives to inform decision-making, ensuring that our programs, services, and initiatives meet the evolving needs of the collision repair industry. Through these collaborative groups, I-CAR gathers insights, feedback, and guidance from industry leaders and professionals to drive innovation, strengthen resources, and support the adoption of best practices.

cards.title: Member Council
cards.body: Serves as the voice of the customer, offering feedback on current and future I-CAR services and programs. Members act as a sounding board for planning and a champion of industry adoption, goodwill, and advocacy, helping I-CAR align its offerings with the needs of repairers, insurers, educators, and suppliers.

cards.title: Segment Advisory
cards.body: Provides segment-specific guidance, insight, and feedback. This council ensures that I-CAR's initiatives address the unique needs and challenges of different sectors within the collision repair industry.

cards.title: Product Development Advisory Council
cards.body: Informs decisions around product and resource development. Its guidance helps I-CAR create tools, solutions, and learning materials that better serve collision repair professionals and the industry at large.

cards.title: OEM Technical Advisory
cards.body: Identifies innovations and updates from equipment manufacturers that impact repair complexity and training requirements. This council helps I-CAR anticipate industry changes and ensure collision repair professionals have the knowledge and skills needed to address emerging vehicle technologies.
